panoramica.options.keybind.desc: The key or mouse button used to take a panorama screenshot.
panoramica.options.keybind.duplicate_des:
This key is also used for:
%s
panoramica.options.resolution.low_256.de: Lowest resolution. Fast to capture and very small on disk, but noticeably softer than Minecraft's modern menu backgrounds.
panoramica.options.resolution.balanced_5: A lightweight middle option. Sharper than 256x256 while still keeping captures quick and files modest.
panoramica.options.resolution.default_10: Recommended default. Matches the size used by modern Minecraft menu panoramas and gives a clean background without being excessive.
panoramica.options.resolution.very_high_: Higher than the normal menu background size. Useful for very large displays, with larger files and a longer capture pause.
panoramica.options.resolution.ultra_2048: Maximum preset. Best when you want extra-sharp panorama files, but it uses the most memory, disk space, and capture time.
panoramica.options.menu_mode.desc: Chooses which panorama is used behind menu screens. If no saved panorama is found, Minecraft's vanilla panorama is shown.
panoramica.options.cycle_interval.desc: How long each saved panorama stays visible when cycling between all panoramas.
panoramica.options.cycle_interval.inacti: Only used when Menu Background is set to Cycle Between All Panoramas.
panoramica.options.storage.desc: Chooses the parent folder for new panorama screenshots. Each capture is still saved in its own timestamped subfolder.
panoramica.options.hide_hud_normal_scree: Hides the in-game HUD before saving normal Minecraft screenshots. This only affects normal screenshots; panorama screenshots always hide the HUD. Menus and other open screens are not hidden.
panoramica.options.preview_mode.desc: Chooses which screenshot types show a small preview in the top-left corner for 10 seconds after capture.
panoramica.options.screenshot_chat_messa: Shows or hides chat messages from normal and panorama screenshots. Screenshots are still saved either way.
panoramica.capture.started: Taking a panorama screenshot. Each image will be %s pixels...
panoramica.capture.in_progress: A panorama screenshot is already being captured.
panoramica.capture.unavailable: Panorama screenshots can only be taken while in a world.
panoramica.capture.partial_failure: Panorama screenshot finished, but at least one face could not be saved. Folder: %s
